correctness.rationale: Boundary inequality flags E_i=1{X_i!=X_{i+1}} are iid Bernoulli(p), since each fixed flag string has q(q-1)^{#ones} realizations. Each distinct output corresponds to an effective nonoverlapping matching. Two matching choices require three symmetric boundary states; the transfer matrix R_p has the claimed cubic characteristic and initial values 1,1+3p,1+6p+2p². Its largest positive beta satisfies beta>alpha² because characteristic at alpha² is p alpha(p-1)<0. Runs 1^K0 have geometric lengths K+1 and rewards log F_{K+2}; iid renewal SLLN and CLT give gamma_q and tau_q², unfinished run geometric tight; strict Jensen proves gamma_q<log alpha. Independent exact distinct-output enumeration tested q=2,n≤6 and q=3,n≤4. No finite test substitutes for renewal arguments.

final_claim: For uniform q-ary words q≥2, radius-one disjoint-adjacent-swap ball volume V_n has squared expectation generating function (1+2pz-p²z²)/(1-(1+p)z-2pz²+p²z³), p=1-1/q, with exponentially inflating relative variance; log V_n/n→gamma_q a.s. and centered log V_n/sqrt n obeys a renewal-reward Gaussian CLT with explicit positive variance.
limitations: One simultaneous layer of disjoint swaps, uniformly independent input, fixed q≥2 only.
